businesses.business: maternal and pediatric specialty physician services

offering_description.value: Pediatrix provides neonatal intensive care, high-risk pregnancy care and pediatric specialty care to patients and hospital partners. Its affiliated clinicians staff hospital units and see patients in outpatient specialty practices.

primary_services.value: neonatology; maternal-fetal medicine; pediatric cardiology; pediatric hospital medicine; pediatric critical care

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals and health systems seeking specialty physician coverage; B2C: newborns, children and patients with high-risk pregnancies

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: professional fees for patient care paid by health insurers, public health programs and patients; project or contract: hospital payments for specialty staffing and on-call coverage

value_chain_position.value: service provider: organizes affiliated physicians and other clinicians to provide specialty care to patients and coverage for hospitals

geography_served.value: US national: hospitals and outpatient practices across multiple U.S. regions

specialization.value: related lines: neonatal intensive care, high-risk obstetrics, pediatric cardiology and other pediatric hospital specialties

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: staffing agreements negotiated with hospitals and health systems; own locations: outpatient specialty offices operated by affiliated practices; other: hospital admissions and referrals from obstetricians, pediatricians and other clinicians

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state clinician licensure, hospital credentialing, Medicare and Medicaid billing rules, and HIPAA privacy requirements

notes: The current scope of smaller pediatric subspecialty programs is uncertain.
